block.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.lore: A silver bowl of very still water. Shows what was, what is, and what you're having for dinner tonight.
gui.guhs.ringh4.doel.steiger: The dock with the elven boats
quest.guhs.ringh4.aankomst: You are in Guhlórien. At the gate stands a familiar elf with very good eyes. And very many opinions.
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.0: You snuggle up by the fire. Sam-guh is snoring before his pans even hit the ground.
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.1: You sleep like a log. A round, chonk log. Until, in the middle of the night, you hear soft little paws...
quest.guhs.ringh4.rust.2: Guhladriel walks to the green dell. That is where her Mirror stands.
quest.guhs.ringh4.klaar: Chapter 4 is done! Ash Vale lies before you. Somewhere out there stands the Black Grill Gate.
quest.guhs.ringh4.zegen: Guhladriel's blessing: in her city you fall as softly as a little leaf. A chonk leaf.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gaven_gekregen: You have the three gifts of Guhladriel: the Light Phial, the Little Elven Cloak and the Elven Rope.
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.zaal: climb the great spiral staircase around the Great Skewer, up to Guhladriel
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.rust: rest on the guest platform (the tree by the gate, at the Rest Fire)
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.spiegel: look into the Mirror in the green dell (right-click)
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.gaven: talk to Guhladriel at the mirror
quest.guhs.ringh4.hint.boot: step into Leguhlas's elven boat at the dock
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.poort.wacht: One moment. My elf eyes see that you're still watching something.
Welcome to Caras Guhladhon! I saw you coming. Three days ago. You were still walking the other way back then.
Lady Guhladriel is waiting up in the Great Skewer. Up the spiral staircase, until you can't go any higher. Don't look down. Or actually do, it's pretty.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.poort.later: This is the golden wood. No touching anything with greasy pawsies, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.0: Welcome, ring-bearer. I knew you would come. I also knew you got lost twice on the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.1: You mourn for Guhdalf. Do not be afraid: a wizard never simply falls. He falls precisely when he means to.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.welkom.2: But now you are tired. On the guest platform a little fire is burning, and there is a sleeping bag that smells of flowers. Go. Sleep.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.rust: You are about to fall over from sleepiness. Rest first, on the guest platform. Then we shall talk, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.spiegel: The Mirror stands in the dell, among the little white flowers. Look into it. If you dare.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.0: Your journey goes on, and I let nobody leave with empty pawsies. Three gifts.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.licht: The Light Phial. The light of our dearest star, in a little jar. Blows smoke away and dazzles the Nine. Do not drink it.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.elfen: The Little Elven Cloak. Crouch, stand very still, and the Eye will think you are a rock. A chonky rock, but still.
And the Elven Rope. It pulls you to any hook you can see. It doesn't itch, says Sam-guh.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.gaven.1: Leguhlas is waiting at the dock with the boats. Farewell, ring-bearer. May your nibbles never run out.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.opnieuw: You lost a gift. I knew it before you did. Here, a new one. And now keep an eye on your things, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.vaarwel: The river is waiting. So is Leguhlas, and he does not like waiting.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.0: You are back. I knew that. The tea is already getting cold.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.1: The Mirror is calm these days. Mostly it shows what we are having for dinner tonight.
quest.guhs.ringh4.guhladriel.na.2: I have stayed small. It suits me well. Small guhs fit better in a hammock.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.donker: The bowl is empty and dark. Guhladriel has to fill it first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.eigen_snoet: All you see is your own snoot. Very pretty.
quest.guhs.ringh4.spiegel.kalm: The mirror is calm again: it has shown you everything. Want another look? Guhdex > Tales > Watch Again, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.later: These boats are made of elven wood. They never sink. Unless Gimguh stands in one.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.wacht: First go to Lady Guhladriel, up in the Great Skewer. The boats won't walk off. They might sail off, but not without me.
First go to Lady Guhladriel, up in the Great Skewer. The boats won't walk off. They might sail off, but not without me.
Lady Guhladriel is waiting for you, up there. I can see her sitting from here. She's looking at her little clock.
You've got bags under your eyes down to your knees. Sleep first, on the guest platform. Then we sail.
Have you looked into the Mirror yet? Down in the dell. I don't dare anymore: last time I saw Gimguh in the bath.
Guhladriel still has something for you, at the mirror. Nobody sails away from here without presents.
quest.guhs.ringh4.leguhlas.steiger.bootj: The boat has gone down the river for a bit. It'll be right back. Elven boats know the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.0: A dwarf guh does not belong on the water. A dwarf guh belongs UNDER the ground. With a sandwich.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.1: That elf says he has forty-three nibbles. I have forty-four. One of them is in my beard.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.2: I asked Lady Guhladriel for a single little hair. She gave me three! And a nibble. I am never leaving.
quest.guhs.ringh4.gimguh.steiger.3: If that boat wobbles, I'm lying down on the bottom. That's not fear. That's ballast.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.nog_niet: Not yet, nyeg. First rest, the Mirror and the gifts of Guhladriel. Then we sail.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.instappen: Hop on in. Sit down, keep your tail inside the boat. We're leaving in a moment!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.erbij: You squeeze into the boat with the others. Snug.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.deco: This boat belongs to Guhladriel herself. Paws off, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.terug_nee: This boat sails back to the tree city. You have to go the other way, ring-bearer.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.terug: The elven boat sails you back to the tree city. It knows the way.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.nog_eens: Another round? Anytime. The statues stay big.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, nyeg! No getting out while we're sailing.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.af: Off we go. The Guhduin: the longest sauce river in the whole Guhbarbecuether. No stirring with your pawsies.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.water: It's wobbling. Tell that elf it's wobbling. I'm not telling him, I don't talk to him.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.rivier: Easy now, Gimguh. It's cheese sauce. If you fall in, you just eat your way to the shore.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.kijk: Look! There, around the bend! The Arguhnath, the Pillars of the Guh Kings!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.groot: ...Nyeg. Those are BIG. Even their ears are bigger than my whole house.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.koningen: The Guh Kings of old, the ancestors of Araguh. They hold up a paw: this far, and not a crumb further.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.sam: I can't swim, boss. But if it's sauce, I'm willing to give it a try, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.tel: Forty-four nibbles. I just looked under the bench. I'm in the lead.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.tel_terug: That one was mine. I put it there. For later. So that's forty-three each.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.aanleg: There is the landing. Nobody can sail any further: around the bend the Guhduin tumbles down, the Sauce Falls of Rauguhs.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.afscheid.0: This is where you go ashore, ring-bearer. Ash Vale begins on the far side, and there stands the Black Grill Gate. My elf eyes can see it already. It does not look cozy.
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.afscheid.1: Take care of yourself. And if you find nibbles on the way: those count for me, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh4.vaart.gezwommen: That works too, boss. Straight through the sauce. Now I'll smell like cheese for three days. Wahoog.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.uitleg: After the mine, everyone is tired and sad. In the golden wood of Guhlórien, Lady Guhladriel lives high up in the trees. Rest, look into her mirror if you dare, and then sail down the Guhduin in the elven boats. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.0: Walk to Guhladriel's tree city. The Super Compass and Sam-guh show the way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.0: The golden wood of Guhlórien, quite a long walk
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.1: Talk to Leguhlas at the gate of the tree city.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.1: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.2: Climb the great spiral staircase around the Great Skewer and talk to Lady Guhladriel in her hall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.2: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.3: Go to the guest platform (the tree by the gate, up the stairs) and snuggle up by the Rest Fire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.3: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.4: Walk to the green dell in the tree city and look into the Mirror of Guhladriel (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.4: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.5: Talk to Guhladriel at the mirror. She has something for you. Three somethings.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.5: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.6: Walk to the dock and step into Leguhlas's elven boat. Stay seated until the far side.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.waar.6: Caras Guhladhon, the tree city in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.nu.klaar: You sailed down the Guhduin, past the Arguhnath. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.1: Talk to Leguhlas at the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.2: Climb to Guhladriel in the Great Skewer
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.4: Look into the Mirror of Guhladriel
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.5: Talk to Guhladriel at the mirror
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h4.kort.6: Step into the elven boat at the dock
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.0: Guhdalf has fallen into the deep. Nobody is hungry. Not even Pippguh, and that's saying something.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.1: The company stumbles out of the mine and into a wood where the satay trees turn gold: Guhlórien.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.2: High in the branches lives Lady Guhladriel. She knows everything. Even what you sneakily ate yesterday.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h4.regel.3: Rest, ring-bearer. Tomorrow the river awaits. And tonight... a mirror. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.nacht: The middle of the night. Soft little paws on the moss. Guhladriel walks to the dell...
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.kijk: Will you look into the Mirror, ring-bearer?
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.snoet: All I see is my own snoot, boss. There's still stew on it, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.dingen: The Mirror shows things that were, things that are... and things that have yet to be baked.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.gouw: You see the Nibble Shire. The party tent. The long tables...
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.kruimels: ...and Mikas everywhere. They are eating ALL the nibbles. Even the crumbs. Even the ones under the bench.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.oog: Then the water turns red. An EYE. An enormous Mika eye, and it is looking straight at you!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.trek: The Eye of Sauceron: "I see you... Do you have my nibble? I'm only a TINY bit hungry!"
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.weet: I know what it is you saw. For it is also in my mind. And it is also rumbling in my tummy.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.aanbod: Do you want the ring, then? Here. Then I'm nicely rid of it, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.koningin: In place of a Dark Lord you would have a QUEEN! Not dark, but ROUND and CHONK as the dawn!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.houden: All shall love me... and bring me NIBBLES! Buckets full!
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.test: ...No. I pass the test. I will stay small, I will remain Guhladriel, and I'll just eat my own nibbles.
scene.guhs.ringh4_spiegel.bed: Can I go back to bed now, boss? Nyeg.

Look into the Mirror of Guhladriel

Sail down the Guhduin, between the two Guh Kings of the Arguhnath
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h4_kl: Finish chapter 4: The Mirror of Guhladriel
